findings.claim: Earth/Planetary/Space is internally heterogeneous: cosmology/spacetime is a known-but-unworked World frontier, whereas Earth-system sciences lack a dedicated current research programme in the bounded scan.
World cannot be lifted into Earth/Space field ownership because current World authority excludes domain-specific mechanisms and explicitly records cosmology/spacetime as unexplored.
No dedicated current Earth/Planetary/Space semantic programme was found in sampled current owner corpora.
The strongest current region-level posture is dedicated owner not established with heterogeneous research standing; untouchedness is not established and no owner is admitted.

evidence: Human current corpus targeted scan returned zero dedicated Earth/geoscience/climate/astronomy/planetary programme hits.
Shared Research current corpus targeted scan returned zero dedicated hits.
Computing matches were concentrated in industrial-history/methodology evidence rather than an Earth/Space semantic owner.
World has limited cosmology/spacetime frontier material but no dedicated Earth-system sciences programme surface.
hypotheses.interpretation: No current dedicated Earth/Planetary/Space programme was found in the bounded current-corpus scan. This does not establish exhaustive historical absence.
hypotheses.name: HIDDEN_OR_UNPUBLISHED_EXISTING_DEDICATED_PROGRAMME

evidence: World owner contract owns cross-domain Reality semantics and thin cross-regime grammar, but excludes domain-specific mechanisms.
World current-stage closeout labels relativity/spacetime/cosmology as an Unexplored continent rather than current owned field truth.
Earth-system disciplines such as geology, atmospheric science, oceanography, climate science and soil science do not appear as current World owner-native programmes.
hypotheses.interpretation: World may own generic Reality abstractions discovered through future Earth/space research, but current owner authority cannot be lifted into geoscience, climate, astronomy or planetary-science field coverage.
hypotheses.name: LEGITIMATE_EXTENSION_OF_EXISTING_OWNER

evidence: No current published owner mapping candidate reaches any of the 14 region members.
Bounded current-corpus scan found no dedicated programme.
Legacy conversations, non-current repositories and future owner formation are not exhaustively closed.
hypotheses.interpretation: Dedicated current owner/programme is not established; permanent or historical absence is not established.
hypotheses.name: GENUINELY_ABSENT_SEMANTIC_PROGRAMME
